import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from online_matching.match_p4 import BankMatcher
PADDING=1514
for n, L in [(1024,16),(2048,16),(4096,16),(2048,8)]:
    patterns=[]
    for i in range(n):
        iv=[[0,100]] + [[0,3028]]*(L-1)
        patterns.append((L, iv))
    m=BankMatcher(patterns)
    stream=[PADDING]*L + [1600+(i%50) for i in range(200000)]
    start=time.time()
    hits=0
    for pos in range(L, L+200000):
        if m.suffix_match(stream, pos): hits+=1
    print('n=%d L=%d matches=%d %.2fs' % (n,L,hits,time.time()-start))
PYEOF
